cover_headline: Freshworks Alumni Raise $53 Million for Dreamteam, an AI-Native CRM Challenger
facts: Dreamteam has raised $53 million across a seed round led by Together Fund and a Series A led by Accel, with Premji Invest participating
Dreamteam signed more than 100 customers across 13 countries in the three months since it began actively selling
The California-based company employs more than 35 people, with its engineering team in Chennai

quote.text: We see this as an electric-car moment for systems of record.
quote.speaker: Anand Venkatraman

end.headline: Freshworks Alumni Raise $53 Million for Dreamteam, an AI-Native CRM Challenger
end.line: Three former Freshworks executives are building an AI-native CRM whose Company Brain builds a living record from emails and meetings.
